# PiTTy v0.6.0

## Independent Conversation Tabs

- New tab strip above the transcript: run multiple conversations side by side, each backed by its own live Pi process that keeps streaming in the background.
- `+` opens a fresh session as a new tab; `×` closes a tab and stops only its process; Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycle; up to 8 tabs with an actionable toast at the cap.
- Switching tabs rebinds the UI instantly — no restarts, nothing lost. Only the active tab drives status, polling, dialogs, and keyboard flows; extension prompts arriving on background tabs queue behind a badge and surface when you switch to them.
- Prompt drafts, expansion state, and prompt history are private per tab: switching never deletes what you were typing.

## Fork Conversations From Any Message

- Cyan `⑂ fork` affordance on user messages and a fork symbol in the tab strip opening a searchable picker of fork points.
- Forking branches before the selected message into a new active tab while the original conversation is preserved as a background tab; streaming tabs ask first; the tab cap is checked before forking so the original can never be stranded.

## Reliability Fixes From Real Multi-Tab Use

- Ctrl+P / model selection works reliably on freshly opened tabs (readiness gating, global model cache with instant open, single-flight fetch).
- Expand/collapse toggles including "see diff" respond on first click again.
- App exit stops every tab's Pi process; closing a tab fully disposes its runtime.

## Subagent Tool Clarity

- Subagent launch blocks render `agent · model · mode` plus a task gist instead of raw JSON, outcome-first states (`✓ completed · took 2m 10s`, `✗ failed`), and workflow child counts.
- "Click to expand" appears only when expanding reveals more content.
- Sidebar rows show `starting…` instead of `0 tools` until counts exist.
